format_badge_policy: Category buttons count registry extensions and stay on one line inside the 608 logical-pixel content column. Overflow reveals square previous and next buttons at the right edge. Their sides equal the extension tag height at the current text size, and they share the tags’ corner radius. Each moves by the width of the visible category area and is disabled at its boundary. Keyboard focus reveals a clipped category. All category names share one baseline across the row. Counts share a separate baseline that aligns the center of a reference digit with the center of a reference capital. A rounded count tag sits closer to its own name than to the next category and adopts the selection palette when expanded. Word shape and selection weight do not move either baseline. Archives is open initially. At most one group is open. Its preview elides at the right on one line. The format area follows the page surface with no background fill, perimeter border or horizontal divider. Selected categories use accent text and weight. Extension tags use the regular interface font, a subtle themed fill, the shared thin field outline and a 3-logical-pixel radius. Center the lowercase body on a shared baseline. Ascenders and descenders keep their natural positions. Keep tags whole and show an ellipsis for overflow. The association shortcut opens the existing settings controls.
titlebar_policy: reuse existing main titlebar unchanged; welcome content only
